nodes.note: Holding Lane, three wide with a verge on its south side and lamps on the verge; every holding opens onto it.

holds.use: the family's house: one long room with the hearth, the table and the beds
the cart shed against the house's east wall, through a door from the house, its own door onto the back yard
the front strip between the lane's gate and the house door
the back yard: the washing line, the vegetable rows and the shed's door
a bed of flowers under the front windows, behind a low hedge

nodes.note: A house on its own ground: an L of the house and the cart shed, the front strip to the door, the back yard behind, a flower bed behind the hedge.

holds.use: the smith's shop at the lane with its counter, and behind it the workroom with the forge and the anvil
the work yard beside the shop: the grindstone, the quench and the wood stack
the iron store in the yard's corner, shut

nodes.note: The smith's holding: the shop and workroom at the lane's edge, the work yard beside it, the iron store in the yard's corner.

holds.use: the chapel: one hall under its roof, the altar at the north end

nodes.note: The chapel standing alone on its ground: one structure that is the whole of the plot, cut as a sky-open plot of one part.
The same chapel cut the other way: a lidded box with no parts, beside the plot of one structure, so the two spellings stand side by side.

holds.use: the byre: stalls and hay for the cattle, its door onto the pen
the pen round the byre where the cattle stand, fenced from the lane

nodes.note: The farm's edge at the lane's end: the byre and the pen round it.
